tool: Harmony generate_image (Codex built-in image generation, medium effort)
destination: Treehouse title room: clean plate, separate object layers and the window view
processing: tools/title_room.py registers each generated object to the approved painting (coarse-to-fine shift and scale), keeps the approved pixels wherever the object was visible and matches, uses generated pixels at edges and parts other objects hid, and composes the plate from the approved painting outside the objects' convex footprints and the removed picture board. Opaque plates and composites export as q50 method-6 AVIF; cut-outs and glows as exact lossless AVIF.

sources.note: Copies of the approved title-layers backgrounds (tiger removed).
